_help: Public template for the AutoResearch preset configuration. Copy this file to config.default.json (or run `npm run init`, which seeds it) and edit roleProfiles there for your deployment. config.default.json is local-only and gitignored — personal model routing is never committed. Internal plans, receipts, packets, and run artifacts live in hidden .research-agent/, the single runtime artifact root. Completed user-facing deliverables publish under outputs/. MODEL ASSIGNMENT IS CENTRALIZED IN roleProfiles BELOW: every role has exactly one entry there. An optional roleProfiles.<role>.modelFallbacks array is an ordered handoff chain: when a model fails with a provider/route error the role runner steps to the next entry, and a per-workspace breaker (<artifactRoot>/model-breaker.json) skips a rate-limited model until the cooldown expires. There is no separate roleModels bucket and no per-role tool list here — per-role tools are fixed by the built-in role manifest. judgePanel is an optional per-judge override and only takes effect when research_judge.model is omitted. _recognizedModels is the pick list of valid 'provider/model' strings (refresh with autoresearch_list_models; unrecognized strings are flagged by autoresearch_dependency_check). The integration editor must use a multimodal model for visual inspection — if your deployment's default is text-only, point research_integration_editor at a multimodal model in roleProfiles. Each role may set reasoningEffort to a provider-supported effort identifier; unset roles use the provider default. These template defaults run every role on deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-flash; customize per deployment in config.default.json.
